jobs.title: Chief Information Officer/Director, Digital Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

About Red Deer

Red Deer sits at the heart of Central Alberta along the QEII corridor, perfectly positioned between Calgary and Edmonton. With more than 100,000 residents and a regional reach of over 300,000, it’s a growing hub for business, services, and opportunity.

Here, big-city amenities meet small-city ease. Enjoy abundant parks and trails, vibrant arts and culture, excellent recreation and education, and a strong sense of community.

With easy access to lakes, outdoor adventures, and the mountains, plus a thriving economy and high quality of life, Red Deer is an inviting place to live, work, and grow.

About The City Of Red Deer Municipal Government

The City of Red Deer is a dynamic municipal organization with a $480M operating budget, a $60M capital program, and a workforce of nearly 1,700 employees. It is focused on growing with purpose by attracting talented, community-minded people who want to make a difference.

Guided by the vision “Our City, One Voice,” Red Deer is building a thriving, inclusive, and connected community, with priorities centered on a vibrant economy, community wellbeing, and strong engagement.

At its core, the City values its people, embracing diverse perspectives and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and shared success.

Are you a visionary technology leader who can turn digital possibilities into meaningful organizational impact?

The City of Red Deer is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services to help shape the future of technology and digital service delivery across our organization. This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise technology strategy, champion innovation and modernization, and build the secure, reliable digital foundations that support essential municipal services. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, people and organizational transformation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact on how we work, serve and grow.

The Opportunity

The City of Red Deer is seeking an accomplished and innovative technology executive to join our Corporate Performance and Supports Division as Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services
.

Reporting to the Deputy Executive Director, Corporate Performance and Supports, the CIO will provide strategic and operational leadership for the City's enterprise technology environment, guiding digital modernization while ensuring the reliability, security and sustainability of the technology services that support municipal operations and community service delivery.

Leading a diverse team of approximately 50 professionals, the CIO will play a pivotal role in shaping the City's technology future, strengthening organizational capabilities and translating emerging digital opportunities into practical, sustainable solutions.

With responsibility for a broad enterprise portfolio, the successful candidate will provide leadership in six key areas:

Digital Strategy, Governance and Modernization: Shape and advance the City's enterprise technology strategy, architecture and roadmap. Champion innovation, automation and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to enable organizational improvement and enhance municipal service delivery.
Technology Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Resilience: Provide executive oversight of the City's technology infrastructure, cybersecurity and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring critical systems and services remain secure, reliable and resilient in an increasingly complex digital environment.
Enterprise Solutions and Technology Delivery: Lead the planning, integration and modernization of enterprise applications and technology solutions, working collaboratively across departments to align investments with organizational priorities and deliver sustainable business value.
Technical Services and Customer Experience: Foster a service-oriented technology culture, strengthening technical support, operational performance and the employee experience through responsive, reliable and continuously improving digital services.
Enterprise Data Architecture and Integration: Advance the technical foundations that enable secure, connected and accessible organizational data, supporting effective integration, analytics and informed decision-making across the City.
People Leadership and Financial Stewardship: Inspire and develop a high-performing Digital Services team, strengthen leadership capacity and oversee significant technology investments, partnerships and service delivery models to ensure accountability, sustainability and value.

As the City's senior technology advisor, the CIO will work closely with executive leadership, departments and Council, as required, to navigate complex technology decisions, balance competing priorities and position the organization for long-term success.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to lead complex enterprise technology environments. They are a strategic thinker and accomplished people leader who understands the importance of operational excellence while embracing opportunities for innovation and transformation.

They bring sound judgment, exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and the ability to translate complex technical considerations into clear, practical advice. Equally comfortable setting long-term direction and navigating immediate operational challenges, they inspire confidence, build collaborative partnerships and lead meaningful organizational change.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a technology leader who wants to do more than manage systems. It is an opportunity to shape digital direction, build organizational capability and help transform how municipal services are delivered for the community of Red Deer.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related technical field. An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible technology leadership experience may be considered.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience in Information Technology or Digital Services, including 5+ years in a technology leadership role with significant responsibility for enterprise technology services, teams and operations.
Experience developing and implementing organization-wide technology strategies, including infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, data management and digital modernization.
Experience leading complex technology and data transformation initiatives and supporting teams through organizational change.
Experience managing significant operating and capital budgets, technology investments, vendor relationships and contracts.
Strong technical understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, data governance and emerging technologies.
Ability to provide sound strategic and operational advice to senior leaders. Strong judgment and the ability to explain complex technology matters to non-technical audiences.
Experience leading collaborative, accountable teams, developing leaders and building strong working relationships across an organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Graduate education in a related field.
Professional certifications in enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, data and analytics, artificial intelligence, technology service management or project management.
Senior technology leadership experience in a municipality, public-sector organization, utility or similarly complex organization.
Experience assessing different technology service delivery options, including internal services, managed services, cloud solutions and external partnerships.
Experience leading organization-wide digital modernization and introducing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Knowledge of municipal operations, public-sector accountability, privacy legislation and regulatory requirements.

What We Offer

In addition to the competitive wages, we offer an excellent benefit package, pension plans, spending accounts and professional development opportunities to support your career growth.

We are committed to a healthy, vibrant, and sustainable community. Our employees are the cornerstone of our organization and working with us will provide you with work-life balance, career growth and job stability.

The opportunity to work in an ever-growing environment and to work with a dedicated and passionate group of people.

Affiliation:
Exempt

Status:
Regular Full-time

Remuneration:
$75.63 to $94.53 per hour ($148,045 to $185,042 per annum)

Hours of Work:
75 hours biweekly; Monday to Friday, some evening and weekend work may be required when needed.

Additional Information:
Closing date is November 25, 2026, or until a suitable candidate has been found.

The City of Red Deer does not permit the use of unauthorized internet resources or Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT or any other form of AI) during interviews or any supervised or timed assessments. Any violation may be investigated and result in serious consequences, including the rejection of your application.

We thank you for your application. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

About Us

We are a municipal government, eager to meet tomorrow's challenges. Our employees are the cornerstone of our organization. We are always seeking creative and skilled individuals with the ability and desire to lead in our dynamic workplace. Each of our employees brings diverse experiences and perspectives, as well as unique skills and talents to the job. Our diverse employee base ensures an environment where individual, team, and organizational successes are embraced and celebrated. We strive to ensure a supportive and respectful work environment for all. Employees are treated fairly and have equal opportunity within the organization to thrive and attain their highest potential. We welcome your application and look forward to discussing how The City of Red Deer can become your next career choice.

Job Description:

The VP Finance, Global Technology oversees key financial and strategic investment items for Global Technology. This role will report to the SVP & CFO, Global Technology, Finance Strategy and Operations

The role is responsible for overseeing Enterprise-wide view of technology financial performance, investment priorities and value realization. The VP partners closely with Technology executives, Business Group Finance leaders, Procurement, and other corporate functions to ensure technology resources and investments are aligned to enterprise strategy and deliver sustainable business value.

The role operates across geographies, businesses and functions and requires the ability to influence decisions in a highly matrixed global financial-services environment.

Key Role Accountabilities

Act as the senior Finance partner and trusted advisor to Global Technology leadership.
Lead the financial planning, forecasting, reporting and performance-management processes for Global Technology.
Develop clear insights on technology cost, investment trends, risks and opportunities for senior management.
Bring an enterprise perspective to decisions, balancing Technology priorities with the needs of individual businesses and geographies.
Establish transparency into the Enterprise technology cost base and its key economic drivers.
Provide insight into run versus change spend, workforce, vendors, infrastructure, software and major transformation investments.
Partner with Technology leadership on productivity, modernization and transformation.
Translate Technology strategies into clear financial implications, resource requirements and investment choices.
Drive disciplined management of financial commitments and emerging risks.
Provide financial leadership across the technology investment portfolio.
Establish financial frameworks for evaluating and prioritizing competing investments including AI.
Challenge investment assumptions, expected benefits, implementation costs and ongoing operating implications.
Lead continued evolution of Enterprise technology cost allocation transparency and appropriate financial discipline.
Ensure business leaders understand the services and technology capabilities driving their costs.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with the Business Group finance teams
Build, attract and develop a strong and diverse team
As the team and company grow, the responsibilities of this position may expand to adapt to changing organizational goals.

Key Skills & Attributes

Proven experience at building and developing a strong team
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and team building skills.
Excellent oral, written and, presentation skills, with strong attention to detail.
Proven ability to influence the performance of others to deliver results.
Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to collaborate and drive execution across functions and geographies.
Ability to apply advanced financial concepts and capabilities across business activities.
Proven experience leading in a matrix model with the ability to foster effective working relationships and negotiate solutions.
Effective communication, negotiation, and conflict management skills.
Effective change management, through impact and influence skills.

Education And Experience

Accounting Designation with 10+ years of experience in the financial management field in a senior leadership role or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven experience leading in a matrix model across multiple businesses, functions and geographies
Experience with FP&A technology cost management, investment governance, allocation methodologies and/or large transformation portfolios.
Experience operating within a large, complex, matrixed organization.
Experience supporting senior executives and influencing decisions across business groups and geographies
Demonstrated experience leading teams through change.

jobs.title: Global Head of Architecture
jobs.description:
Build the future of AI and data with us

Datatonic is a leading Google Cloud partner specialising in data and AI. We help organisations design, build and operate production AI systems, from governed data foundations and machine learning platforms to generative AI applications and agentic workflows. Our teams combine Google Cloud, software engineering, machine learning, data engineering and analytics expertise with the consulting skills needed to turn complex business requirements into reliable products.

Your mission

As Architecture Lead, you will be a hands-on Cloud Architect who also leads Datatonic's team of architects. You will design and build cloud, data and application estates yourself, while setting the standards, growing the people and owning the quality of architecture across our client work.

You will split your time between three things: delivering architecture on our most complex engagements, leading and developing a team of architects, and representing Datatonic as a technical authority with clients and in pre-sales.

What You'll Do

Hands-on architecture

Target architecture: Design and lead target architectures across cloud, data and application estates on Google Cloud, covering the platforms and the systems that run on them.
Hands-on build: Stay close to the code. Prototype, write infrastructure as code, review pull requests and unblock engineering teams on hard technical problems.
Systems design: Own boundaries, failure modes, security, cost, operability and how each design evolves over time.
Trade-off ownership: Resolve architectural trade-offs across Platform, Data, Analytics, AI, Software and UX.
Delivery governance: Act as design authority on our most complex engagements, making sure what we ship is secure, reliable and maintainable.

Leading the architecture team

People leadership: Line manage and develop a team of architects, including career conversations, performance reviews and growth plans.
Mentorship: Coach architects and discipline leads while leaving delivery ownership with them.
Standards and patterns: Set architecture standards, reference patterns and decision-record practices used across projects and regions.
Capability building: Grow architecture capability through hiring, training, communities of practice and design reviews.
Staffing: Work with delivery leadership to match architects to engagements.

Clients and market

Pre-sales: Shape solution architecture, estimates and proposals, especially where estate design carries the risk.
Client leadership: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, from engineering leads to CTOs.
Thought leadership: Help shape service propositions and represent Datatonic as a technical authority at events and with Google Cloud.

Working with agents

You will use agents throughout engineering delivery and maintain the agents that support the architecture discipline, including their versioning, evaluation, operation and continuous improvement. This covers agents for option analysis, decision-record drafts, consistency checks against established patterns, and initial threat and cost assessments.

What You'll Bring

Cloud architecture depth: Extensive hands-on experience designing and building production systems on Google Cloud (or AWS/Azure with a strong interest in GCP).
Engineering foundation: Proven depth in at least one engineering discipline (platform, data, software or ML engineering) at Senior 2 / L5 or above.
Demonstrated breadth: Evidence of systems design across disciplines, including networking, security, IAM, data platforms and application architecture.
Hands-on skills: Comfortable with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, and at least one programming language such as Python.
Team leadership: Experience leading, mentoring or line managing engineers or architects, and raising the bar for a whole team.
Client leadership: Client-facing architecture leadership with senior stakeholders, including pre-sales and solution shaping.
Communication: Ability to explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, in writing and in person.

Bonus points if you have

Google Cloud certifications: Professional Cloud Architect or similar.
Complex estates: Experience with multi-cloud, hybrid or complex integration environments.
Architecture methods: Experience applying formal architecture methods (e.g. TOGAF) in complex delivery environments.
AI and data platforms: Experience architecting ML platforms, generative AI applications or agentic systems in production.
Consultancy background: Experience in a consultancy or professional services environment.

What's in it for you?

We believe in empowering our team to thrive, with benefits including:

20 days of paid vacation per calendar year
Public Holidays for your Province of Residence
5 Wellness days (sickness, personal time, mental health)
5 Lifestyle days (religious events, volunteer day, sick day)
Matching Group Retirement Savings Plan after 3 months
Competitive Group Insurance plan on Day 1 - individual premium paid 100%!
Virtual Medicine and Family Assistance Program - 100% employer-paid!
Home office budget - We are 100% remote!
CAD $70/month for internet/phone expenses
Company-supplied MacBook Pro or Air

CAD $400/year for books, relevant app subscriptions or an e-reader.
Opportunities for paid certifications
Opportunities for professional and personal learning through Udemy Business
Regular company off-sites and meetups

Why Datatonic?

Datatonic is a UK-based company with an Americas division located in Canada. The Canadian team operates remotely, with members distributed across North and South America. This role is open to candidates located anywhere in Canada.

Join us to work alongside AI enthusiasts and data experts who are shaping tomorrow. At Datatonic, innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s embedded in everything we do. If you’re ready to inspire change and deliver value at the forefront of data and AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Description:

This is a high-visibility strategy role supporting the SVP, Chief Experience, Digital and AI Officer and Chief Information Officer and the broader leadership team on high-priority questions facing the organization. Reporting to the AVP, Business Insights & Strategic Execution, a strategic and execution partner to the SVP, the Director will work across AI, digital, client experience and technology to frame complex problems, generate insights, develop executive recommendations and help mobilize priority initiatives.

The role offers broad exposure across some of Sunlife Canada’s most important transformation priorities and the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders on issues ranging from emerging AI opportunities and digital and client priorities to strategic investments, organizational effectiveness and transformation. The successful candidate will bring rigorous, hypothesis-driven problem solving, strong business and financial judgment, and exceptional executive communication skills.

Deep technology expertise is not required. We are looking for an exceptional strategist and problem solver who is intellectually curious about AI, digital and technology and able to build fluency quickly.

What will you do?

Strategic problem solving: lead high-priority strategic assignments from problem definition through recommendation and mobilization, structuring ambiguous questions, developing the fact base, evaluating alternatives and helping leadership translate decisions into action.
Analysis and insight: apply consulting-style problem solving, including hypothesis development, market and competitive analysis, benchmarking, financial modeling, scenario analysis and synthesis of internal and external perspectives.
Executive decision support and storytelling: develop crisp, answer-first executive narratives and decision materials that turn complex analysis into clear choices, recommendations, trade-offs and implications.
Cross-functional alignment: partner with leaders across business, technology, finance, risk, data, digital and corporate functions to test perspectives, build alignment and advance priority initiatives.
Mobilization and execution support: translate strategic recommendations into actionable plans, including sequencing, dependencies, measures of success, accountabilities and key executive decisions.
Project leadership: independently manage high-priority assignments or strategic initiatives and provide day-to-day leadership to cross-functional teams contributing to the work, where needed.

What do you need to succeed?

Education & Experience

5+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally spanning management consulting, corporate strategy, and/or strategic planning.
Management consulting or comparable strategy experience is strongly preferred, with demonstrated strength in hypothesis-driven problem solving, qualitative and quantitative analysis, and executive communication.
University degree in business, economics, engineering, or another relevant discipline; an MBA or other relevant graduate degree is an asset.
Demonstrated experience independently structuring ambiguous problems, conducting rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, and translating findings into actionable recommendations to senior executives.
Experience with AI, digital, client experience, technology or business transformation is an asset.
Demonstrated experience working across functions, navigating organizational complexity and influencing stakeholders.
Experience in financial services or another large, matrixed organization is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to develop concise, answer-first presentations and written recommendations.
Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate strategic choices, benefits, costs, risks and trade-offs.
Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving and highly visible situations.
Ability to work effectively with senior executives and build alignment across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.
Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities, including experience developing executive-level presentations and analytical models. Experience with other analytical tools or dashboards is an asset.
Intellectual curiosity and sufficient fluency in AI, digital and technology topics to engage credibly with subject-matter experts and connect emerging capabilities to business outcomes.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
Being part of our journey in developing the next greatest digital experience
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Digital Marketing Director you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

About Draganfly

Draganfly Inc. (the “Company”) has been a recognized technology leader within the commercial UAV space for over two decades. We helped establish the commercial market & adoption of multi-rotor helicopters for public safety, agriculture, aerial imaging, & more. As a leader who helped shape the industry, Draganfly’s focus is on the sale of drone products and services, contract engineering & custom integration product development, and health monitoring products and services.

Additional information on our expertise, projects, and culture can be found at https://draganfly.com/

We are looking for a strategic, highly hands-on, execution-focused Director, Enterprise Applications to lead the strategy, transformation, delivery and operation of Draganfly’s core business platforms and processes, including ERP and procurement systems. This is a working leadership role, not a purely strategic or people-management position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally analyze business processes, configure and optimize systems, troubleshoot issues, work with data and integrations, lead implementations, test solutions, and drive projects through completion. While this role will work closely with vendors, consultants and internal teams, the Director must be comfortable rolling up their sleeves and doing the work directly rather than primarily delegating execution to others.

As Draganfly grows across Canada, the US and internationally, this leader will modernize and standardize our application landscape across Draganfly Inc., Draganfly Innovations Inc., Draganfly Innovations USA, Draganfly Defense, USA, and Candrone. The role requires a leader who can partner with senior executives, work with colleagues within each department, drive execution at scale, and be part of a high-performing team.

This is a remote role, but the successful candidate will need to be willing to travel.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Transformation

Define and execute the enterprise applications strategy and multi-year roadmap across ERP, finance, procurement and related corporate systems.

Lead transformation initiatives that standardize and simplify business processes, modernize legacy tools and consolidate platforms in the cloud.

Align related application roadmaps with Draganfly’s business priorities, growth plans and multi-entity operating structure.

Delivery & Value

Process Standardization

Partner with Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain leaders to define and implement best-practice processes across all entities.

Drive automation and deliver improvements in cycle times, data quality and reporting transparency.

Act as a primary point of contact for process optimization, supporting change management and driving consistency in process standardization.

Architecture & Integration

Define the target-state application architecture and integration patterns across the ERP and dependent data platforms.

Ensure systems are secure, auditable and integrated through scalable APIs and middleware, and guide build-versus-buy decisions.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure enterprise platforms meet public company financial controls and audit requirements (Canada and US), including COSO Framework, SOX404b protocols, as well as data governance and privacy obligations.

Collaborate closely with IT and Security to ensure compliance with security standards and business continuity planning.

Support export control and trade compliance requirements as required through appropriate system controls, data, and reporting.

Manage platform vendors, implementation partners and consultants, holding them accountable for delivery performance, cost, and quality.

Working manager that can also build and lead a high-performing enterprise applications team, with clear operating models for project delivery, production support and release and change management.

You bring a positive, solutions-oriented mindset, thrive in a role where attention to detail and controls matter, and are willing to travel as needed.

10+ years in enterprise applications, IT or digital transformation, including 5+ years in leadership roles leading cross-functional teams.

Proven success leading ERP and finance system implementations or transformations, ideally in a multi-entity environment.

Deep experience with ERP platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central), HRIS (e.g. Rippling, Workday) and CLM/procurement platforms.

Track record of delivering complex, multi-year programs with measurable business outcomes.

Strong understanding of finance systems, including general ledger, fixed assets, revenue, consolidation, and reporting.

Strong working knowledge of R2R, P2P, O2C, and H2R processes.

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Digital Marketing Director you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.
